I understand why you are checking. Yes, a damaged item is handled slightly differently from a standard return at Maison Close: in the return portal you should select Defective/Damaged item as the reason, and the outcome available is refund.

For both damaged items and normal returns, the return is free, you use the same return portal here: https://www.maison-close.us/a/return, and you need to print three copies of your invoice for customs and place them in a transparent pouch on the outside of the parcel. For a standard return, the usual return conditions still apply, including the 30-day window and item condition requirements.

turns.q: Do you need photos, and where do I send them?
turns.replyTail:
If you can use the return portal, you do not need to send photos separately. Please submit the request here: https://www.maison-close.us/a/return and select Defective/Damaged item.

Photos are only needed if you cannot access the portal or if it is not working. In that case, please send your order number, the product reference, and clear photos showing the damage, and I will pass your request to our team. I also need your email address so a person can follow up.
